entities.name: António Xavier Pereira Coutinho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António Xavier Pereira Coutinho was a Portuguese botanist and agronomist, born in Santo Estêvão, Lisbon. He published two editions of The Flora of Portugal, and is the scientific authority for a hundred plant taxa, across many families. He died at Alcabideche, aged 87
